method: Execute actual JavaScript controller and coordinator; exhaustive finite command traces plus targeted async ownership, saved-entry, manual-date rejection, destroy-during-save, axis-click, inert-ownership, refused-entry, unanswered-gate and start-reread cases and isolated real-source negative controls

entries: toolbar entry with a saved record
toolbar entry before the gate answers
date confirmation after the gate answers T3
toolbar entry under an allowed gate
date confirmation after the gate refuses
startReread.availability: allowed at entry, refused before confirmation

excluded: Native browser DOM, rendering and events
Real forecast generation and scoring in coordinator doubles
Cutoff-model loading in the coordinator fixture
Forecast availability that changes after start passes its gate, while the session loads or plays
Wheel, keyboard and drag navigation beyond axis-click start confirmation

original.scope: Actual coordinator and controller with deterministic DOM, source, forecast and renderer doubles; exhaustive bounded traces without state merging
